description: Answer "what free credits / free tier / startup program can I get for X". Ranked, verified offers matching a need such as "free speech to text credits", "GPU for a bootstrapped startup" or "student LLM API credits". Each result has credit_value, eligibility, how_to_claim, claim_url, source_url, source_snippet (verbatim vendor quote), last_verified, value_usd (explicit one-time USD amount or null), audience, and live claims / claims_7d / votes counts (real visitors, never padded; null if unavailable). filters.sort orders by relevance (default), popular (most claimed this week), votes, newest, verified (most recently re-checked), value (largest stated USD credit) or az. need may be empty when you only filter/sort. Closed offers are excluded unless filters.status is "all"/"closed" or include_closed is true. claim_redirect_url sends the user to the vendor and counts the claim anonymously; claim_url is the direct vendor link.

audience.description: Who can claim: startup, student, anyone, members (members = customers of a bank/marketplace partner). Comma-separate to require several.

category.description: Category slug: cloud-gpu, llm-api, agents-automation, observability, voice-audio, dev-tools, perk-marketplace, database-backend, vector-db, image-video, productivity, accelerator.

include_closed.description: Include offers that have closed (default false).

min_value.description: Only offers whose credit_value leads with an explicit one-time USD amount of at least this much (e.g. 10000).

no_application.description: Only offers you can use right after signup (free tiers, signup credits, promo codes); no application or approval.

sort.description: relevance (default), popular, votes, newest, verified, value, az.

student.description: Only offers for students, educators or researchers.

type.description: Offer type slug: startup-program, free-tier, signup-credit, student-education, marketplace-perk, promo-code, accelerator-perk.

need.description: What the user wants credits for, in plain words. E.g. "speech to text", "GPU compute for a bootstrapped startup", "vector database". May be empty ("") to list by filters and sort only.

name: find_credits
title: Find free credits for a need
